newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ING undecided on possible share issue.
newsitem.headline: ING undecided on possible share issue.

text.p: ING Groep NV (ING) said on Wednesday it had not yet decided whether it would issue new shares when it lists its shares in New York.
The New York listing is planned for June 1997.
"We have not decided yet whether we will offer new shares," board member Cees Maas told reporters.
"I'm not saying that it is not happening and I'm not saying that it is happening," he said.
He added it depended on market conditions.
"Generally speaking, if an offering of new shares takes place along with a new listing it is usually a small amount....in the range of one percent of the shares outstanding," he said.
Rival Dutch financial group ABN AMRO plans to buy back one percent of its own shares for further sale to U.S. investors as part of its planned New York listing, possibly in May.
